title: Add fusiondb-cli admin operations tool
description: Add a production operations CLI that wraps FusionDB HTTP health, query, metadata, metrics, checkpoint, and compaction endpoints.

criteria: A fusiondb-cli binary is registered in Cargo.toml.
The CLI supports health, query, tables, metrics, prometheus, slow-queries, checkpoint, compact/vacuum, capabilities, and auth-context commands.
CLI request construction is covered by offline unit tests.
Roadmap and README no longer list Admin CLI as missing.

notes: The CLI is intentionally HTTP-backed so it can operate against a running server without linking to storage internals.
The vacuum command is an operator-friendly alias for the existing /compact endpoint.
The --user flag maps to x-fusiondb-user, matching the existing HTTP RBAC middleware.
